title: FlyJoy
description: This mod adds craftable flight items, parachutes, and more. Get your joy from flying today!
body:
# FlyJoy

  I recommend testing the items in a creative mode world first, before trying them in survival mode

  Fabric version requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
  
## Mod Includes:
- Freezing Table
- Flight Cores
- Ice Packs
- Parachutes

### Freezing Table:
  - Upgraded 5x5 crafting table
  - Used to craft Ice Packs and Unbound items
![Freezing Table Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43590bb8abeee2a60a99e3d57ab81b8c1760b039.png)

<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 4 Blue Ice
  - 2 Powder Snow Bucket
  - 1 Crafter
  - 1 End Crystal
  - 1 Calibrated Skulk Sensor
  
</details>



### Flight Cores:
  There are three types of Flight Core. All Flight Cores have these attributes:
  - Hold in main hand or off hand and double-tap jump (triple-tap in creative mode) to start flying
  - Right click while holding to toggle Boost mode
  - Shift +  right click to adjust sounds, particles, flight speed, and boost percentage
  
**Flight Core:**
  - Craftable
  - Dragon Egg is not consumed when crafted
  - Fly up to 64 blocks above the ground
  - Builds up heat while flying, more heat is generated the faster you fly. 100% heat stops flight midair. After landing, Flight Core cools down and is usable again after it reaches 50% heat. 
  - Ice Packs can be used to decrease heat while in flight
  - No fall damage while held, unless overheated
   ![Flight Core Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7667542d733ad4b3771dd7121bc18640076c325b.png)
<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 1 Dragon Egg (not consumed by crafting)
  - 1 Dragon Head
  - 1 Elytra
  - 1 Conduit
  - 1 Nether Star

</details>

**Perfect Flight Core:**
- Craftable
- Dragon Egg is not consumed when crafted
- Unlimited flight height
- Builds up heat while flying, more heat is generated the faster you fly. 100% heat stops flight midair. After landing, Perfect Flight Core cools down and is usable again after it reaches 50% heat.  Perfect Flight Core builds up heat more slowly than Flight Core.
- Ice Packs can be used to decrease heat while in flight
- No fall damage while held, unless overheated
![Perfect Flight Core Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27f8504bc3afcaa98b9c40825644be2308e9bd34.png)
<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 2 End Crystal
  - 1 Dragon Egg (not consumed by crafting)
  - 1 Dragon Head
  - 1 Elytra
  - 1 Conduit
  - 1 Nether Star
  - 1 Flight Core
  - 1 Heavy Core

</details>

**Unbound Flight Core**:
  - Crafted in the Freezing Table
  - Dragon Egg is not consumed when crafted
  - Unlimited flight height
  - No heat buildup
![Unbound Flight Core Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed613c27194079aad58c717ff9e995e1b6ea793a.png)
<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 8 Perfect Ice Pack
  - 4 End Crystal
  - 4 Netherite Block
  - 4 Heavy Core
  - 4 Perfect Flight Core
  - 1 Dragon Egg (not consumed by crafting)

</details>


### Ice Packs:
There are two types of Ice Pack. All Ice Packs have these attributes:
- Crafted in the Freezing Table
- Consumed on use
- Right click to use while holding a Flight Core in the other hand
- Heat reduction is less effective as heat increases
- Maximum of 5 Ice Packs can be used per flight. Heat must reach 0% before another Ice Pack can be used.
    

**Ice Pack**
- Reduces heat by 2-5% per use
![Ice Pack Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d797156fbc6b76aee22a37c5386f942ff6724a19.png)
<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 12 Blue Ice
  - 8 Iron Ingot
  - 4 Copper Ingot
  - 1 Ghast Tear

</details>

**Perfect Ice Pack**
- Reduces heat by 8-15% per use
![Perfect Ice Pack Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/613163ba0de1ed7cf0e63d45652f492223c59c1e.png)
<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 12 Blue Ice
  - 8 Gold Ingot 
  - 4 Copper Ingot
  - 1 Nether Star

</details>


### Parachutes
There are three types of Parachute. All Parachutes have these attributes:
- Right click to activate while falling down
- Will negate fall damage if activated early enough to slow you down

**Parachute**
- Craftable
- Each wool color has a corresponding parachute
- Dyeable after crafting
- One time use
- Drops 0-2 items from the crafting recipe upon landing
![White Parachute Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fb47842f0f9519dee66c8208b121561eec9a1e5.png)
![All Parachute Colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/457f3b5fff1ebe5e9a443ea0ccbe73a92f0e7aa3.png)
<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 3 Wool (any color, cannot mix and match color)
  - 2 String
  - 2 Paper
  - 1 Stick

</details>

**Unbound Parachute**
- Craftable in the Freezing Table
- Unlimited uses
![Unbound Parachute Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c5b28138d134d1b8f36ff33641e382d3d76186f.png)
<details>
<summary>Crafting Ingredients</summary>
  
  - 12 Turtle Scute
  - 4 Heart of the Sea
  - 4 Nether Star
  - 4 Parachute (any color)
  - 1 Flight Core

</details>

**jeb_ Parachute**
- Obtained as a rare drop from killing sheep with the nametag "jeb_" (2.5% chance)
- Rainbow parachute color and item color
- One time use
- Drops 0-2 items from the regular Parachute crafting recipe. Wool color is random.
- There are advancements for obtaining the jeb_ Parachute, and for using the jeb_ Parachute

**Advancements**
- "Wool You Look at That" - obtaining the jeb_ Parachute
- "Prismatic Plummet" - deploying the jeb_ Parachute
- "Taste the Rainbow" - hold 16 jeb_ Parachutes at once
- "We Have Liftoff!" - obtaining the Flight Core
- "Houston, we've had a problem." - core overheating at a lethal height
